name: Dev Squad First Live Build
goal: Build a small, clean, responsive To-Do List web application using HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with no external dependencies, database, API keys or deployment. Required files: index.html, style.css, app.js, README.md. Support adding and displaying tasks, marking them complete/incomplete, deleting them, showing the remaining task count, and saving/restoring tasks with browser localStorage. Use plain-English comments and README instructions. Return the implementation through the existing artifact workflow. Do not claim independent tests or review ran.
